column1: # Key: George Lasry's reconstruction "BNF Francais 4134" (25/05/2022), published as an image (GL/BnF_fr4134.jpg) on S. Tomokiyo's Cryptiana, GL.htm, "Melchior de Sabran (1631)". Rewritten with sign names (shape-like labels) by Claude.

# 0・34・29 は Lasry 氏の表で「o- 34 29. ET」と並ぶ。3つとも et と読んだのは書き写した側の解釈。
